asset: RAIL Wichelsee v2 PBR micro surfaces
notes: All map pixels are procedurally generated. Dimensions, surface construction and colors are visual approximations from the user-provided reference views.
Assign basecolor textures as sRGB. Normal, roughness and ORM textures must be linear/non-color.
Packed ORM channels: R=255 (neutral AO), G=roughness, B=0 (nonmetal). Do not use red as roughness.
For glTF metallicRoughnessTexture use ORM and roughnessFactor=1; metallicFactor=0. With basecolor texture use white baseColorFactor unless deliberately tinting.
OpenGL tangent normals can use strength 1. Avoid converting to DirectX. Use repeat wrapping and mipmapped anisotropic filtering.
No large baked wrinkles, shadows, seams or fabricated logos are included. These micro textures complement modeled macro geometry.
Use the PBR preview only for material inspection, never as a material map.

materials.name: nylon_black
materials.usage: Black woven nylon bag panels. A 500 x 120 mm panel uses about 7.81 x 1.88 UV repeats. Keep the warp parallel to panel length. Mesh folds, seams, piping, straps and zipper should remain separate geometry. Yarn spacing and relief are visual estimates.

materials.name: rubber_black
materials.usage: Black gravel tire tread/rubber micro finish. Repeat at roughly 40 mm per tile; a 700C tread circumference is roughly 54-56 repeats. This map does not assert a tread brand or replace tread-block geometry. Rotate U to follow circumference. Sidewalls can share it at reduced normal scale 0.35.

materials.name: tape_dark_chocolate
materials.usage: Dark chocolate handlebar wrap. Use roughly 40 mm physical tile size; 24 mm tape width spans 0.6 UV units. For continuous bar UVs, scale U along wrapped bar length and V around its circumference. Layer seams should come from winding geometry, not this map.

materials.name: enamel_sage
materials.usage: Sage painted frame tubes; 60 mm per tile. Colour is an approximate albedo inferred from the provided photographs, not a colour-managed swatch. Optional clearcoat 0.15-0.25, clearcoat roughness 0.2-0.3; base metalness stays zero for opaque paint. Normal scale 0.35-1.0, depending on shot distance.
